guidance.claim: The target for new Tanishq stores is 35 to 40 for the year.
guidance.quote: So we look at it in totality, but purely from new stores on Tanishq, I think 35 to 40 is a reasonable range to expect.
guidance.speaker: Ajoy Chawla

guidance.claim: Watch margins are aimed at 15% to 16% in a 1 to 2 year timeframe.
guidance.quote: And on a long term, I would say the kind of investments are required, mid - teen is a good number to aim for, 15% to 16% for the business, at least in th e 1-year, 2-year time frame.
guidance.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia

guidance.claim: Eyewear business growth is expected to close the year around 13% to 14%.
guidance.quote: So as far as our growth outlook is concerned, we believe that we should be closing this year at a slightly higher number than what you are seeing, anywhere between 13% to 14%.
guidance.speaker: Devanshu Bansal

guidance.claim: Growth rates by YTD December should become better than first half growth rates.
guidance.quote: But certainly, at a very broad level, I think by the time we end -- we come to YTD December, our growth rates should have become better than the first half growth rates.
guidance.speaker: Ajoy Chawla

reported.claim: Overall buyer growth was minus 2% for the quarter.
reported.quote: Buyer growth overall has been minus 2% for the quarter.
reported.speaker: Ajoy Chawla

reported.claim: Gold jewellery buyer growth was minus 11% for the quarter.
reported.quote: Gold was minus 11%, largely driven by the sub INR 1 lakh.
reported.speaker: Ajoy Chawla

reported.claim: High-value studded contributed around 14% of the overall business in quarter 2.
reported.quote: So in Quarter 2, it was contributing around 14% of the overall business, and that was 1 percentage point higher than last year Quarter 2.
reported.speaker: Ajoy Chawla

reported.claim: Watch festive period saw a 16% growth over last year.
reported.quote: On watches, the question on festive growth has been high compared to a quarter where we grew about 12%, the festive period sort of saw a 16% growth over last year, same similar period.
reported.speaker: Kuruvilla Markose
